walkthrough.title: Order two pieces a and b by which is bigger: a + b or b + a (as strings). Insertion sort with that rule shows each comparison.

steps.text: Place "3" at position 0: it beats everything after it under the a + b vs b + a rule.
Place "30" at position 1: it beats everything after it under the a + b vs b + a rule.
Place "34" at position 0: it beats everything after it under the a + b vs b + a rule.
Place "5" at position 0: it beats everything after it under the a + b vs b + a rule.
Place "9" at position 0: it beats everything after it under the a + b vs b + a rule.
